title: Dual Cestra
extract:
The Dual Cestra is the dual-wield variant of the  Cestra, a rapid-fire  Corpus sidearm. Compared to its single-handed counterpart, the Dual Cestra sports even faster fire rate, and no spool-up, with a larger magazine size and ammo capacity, at the expense of slower reload speed and lower accuracy.
It can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

High accuracy.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average burst DPS (505.05)
Above average sustained DPS (326.49)
Very high magazine size (120)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Very high ammo max (480)
Very high fire rate (18.75 attacks/sec)
High disposition (●●●●● (1.35x))
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Projectiles have travel time.
High recoil.
Poor ammo economy.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low crit chance (6.00%)
Low damage per shot (26.93)
Low total damage (26)
Below average accuracy (2.00° to 8.00°)
Very low reload speed (3.50 s)
Very low crit multiplier (1.60x)

Acquisition
The Dual Cestra's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Tips
Due to the high recoil of this weapon,  Steady Hands is recommended for better accuracy.

Trivia
The Cestras' barrels rotate slowly clockwise when not in use and spin faster as they are fired.
Released February 5, 2014 in Update 12.0 (2014-02-05).
Color of projectiles is colored by the weapon's energy color.
This is the first akimbo-type weaponry that has a spin-up feature.
This is also the first dual-wield Corpus sidearm.

Bugs
Continuing to hold down the fire button while the Dual Cestra has no ammo in its magazine will not trigger the reload animation. Instead the two will intertwine while the reload icon is being displayed.
Currently the Dual Cestra and its counterparts ( Cestra and  Secura Dual Cestra) cannot increase the damage of  Antimatter Drop.
